associations.rationale: Its type constructs an N-coordinate finitely supported encoding of a partition, providing the variable-count-aware representation used by the formula but defining neither the Vandermonde polynomial nor rho itself.
The type only gives a Fin n-indexed Finsupp family; it exposes the count parameter but does not state that its values form the staircase rho.
The type only gives an n-parameter polynomial with variables Fin n; it does not display the formula establishing that the polynomial is Vandermonde.
